<subject>Hey Darren</subject>
<body>
It's me, Laurie Hicks. Just wanted to check in and say hi!!! How have you been?

I was really sorry to hear about the incident at Port Karratha. It’s hard to imagine something like that happening to such a solid, dependable mate.

Looking forward to your reply!!

Laurie
</body>
